mentions.name: recvmail.net
mentions.description: A service that provides email receiving so AI agents can sign up for accounts that require email verification. Built to solve the problem of agents having no way to receive verification emails during account registration.
mentions.problem: AI agents had no way to receive email verification when signing up for accounts.
mentions.audience: A developers building AI agents that need to complete email-verified account signups.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built https://recvmail.net to scratch my itch for a way for agents to sign up for accounts with email verification.
mentions.author: zmj
